fields.passwordHint: At least {{min}} characters, not a common password.

login.title: Sign in
login.verificationPending: Your address is not verified yet. A new verification link has just been sent to you (at most one every three minutes): check your inbox.

signup.title: Create an account
signup.lead: One account to submit, review, register and take part.

verify.title: Email verification
verify.sent: Check your inbox: a verification link has been sent to you.
verify.sentTo: Check your inbox: if the address {{email}} can be used, an email has just been sent to it.
verify.verified: Your address is verified. You can now sign in.
verify.resendHint: Nothing received? Check your spam folder, then sign in: a new link will be sent to you.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.lead: Enter your account address: you will receive a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account matches this address, an email will be sent to you within the next few minutes. The link is valid for two hours.

reset.title: New password
reset.done: Your password has been changed. You can sign in.

home.title: My account
home.noticeLead: Before continuing, please read how your data is processed.
home.profileLead: First name, last name, institution and country are required to submit a paper.
home.pendingHint: To respond, open the link you received by email.

profile.title: Profile
profile.lead: This information is used for submissions, reviews and registrations.
profile.languageLead: The language chosen with the selector at the top of the page is saved in your account: it is also used for emails.
profile.linkFormat: A complete https:// address is expected.
profile.photoLead: PNG, JPEG or WebP, 5 MB at most. It is resized to 800 pixels and stripped of its metadata (including GPS position). It is only published with your agreement (Privacy page).
profile.linksLead: Optional: shown in the committee directory if you appear in it.

notice.summary: Privacy notice on your data (provisional version)
notice.controller: Data controller: the conference organizing committee. The final text, compliant with the applicable legal framework, will replace this provisional version before the call for papers opens.
notice.purpose: Your data (email address, profile, roles) is used only to manage your participation: accounts, submissions, reviews, programme and registrations.
notice.retention: Sign-ins and sensitive actions are logged for security; the IP address is erased after six months.
notice.rights: You may export your data or request the anonymization of your account from your account area at any time.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.lead: Enter the 6-digit code shown by your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
mfa.stepUpLead: To access the management area, confirm your identity with the code from your authenticator app (or a recovery code).

security.title: Security
security.mfaEnabled: Two-factor authentication is enabled on your account.
security.mfaDisabled: Two-factor authentication is not enabled on your account.
security.mfaRequiredHint: It is mandatory for management roles: administration, chairs, organising and scientific committees.
security.scanLead: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (FreeOTP, Aegis, Google Authenticator…), then enter the code it shows.
security.activated: Two-factor authentication enabled. Write down your recovery codes below.
security.stepUpNeeded: To access management during this session, confirm your code once.
security.recoveryLead: Each one can be used only once. Keep them somewhere safe: they let you sign in if you lose your phone.
security.regenerated: New codes generated: the old ones are no longer valid.
security.disableWarning: Without two-factor authentication, the management area will be refused.
security.resendTooSoon: A link was sent less than three minutes ago: try again a little later.
security.added: Address added: a verification link has been sent to it.

invitation.title: Invitation
invitation.missing: Open the link you received by email to see your invitation.
invitation.notFound: This invitation cannot be found: the link is incomplete, or the invitation was replaced by a newer one.
invitation.summary: {{inviter}} invites you to join the edition “{{edition}}” ({{code}}) as {{role}}.
invitation.signInFirst: To accept, sign in with an account that holds the invited address, or create one.
invitation.signupHint: After creating an account and verifying your address, open the invitation link again.
invitation.otherAddress: Your account does not hold the invited address ({{email}}), or it is not verified. To accept with this account, receive a confirmation link at that address.
invitation.sendLink: Receive a confirmation link at the invited address
invitation.linkHint: The link is valid for one hour and must be opened from this account; you may be asked for your password again.
invitation.linkSent: A confirmation link was sent to the invited address. Open it from this account within the hour.
invitation.linkLead: You asked to link the invited address to your account. Confirm to add it (verified) and accept the invitation.
invitation.reauthHint: If you last confirmed your password more than 5 minutes ago, you will be asked again.
invitation.linkSignIn: Sign in with the account that requested this link, then open it again.
invitation.accepted: Welcome! You now have the role “{{role}}”.
invitation.mfaReminder: Management roles require two-factor authentication: enable it under “Security” if you have not already.

notPending.accepted: This invitation has already been accepted.
notPending.expired: This invitation has expired: ask the organisers for a new one.

directory_listing.title: Public committee directory
directory_listing.lead: Optional: if you agree, your name, institution, country and public links may appear in the conference's public list of committees. You can withdraw your agreement at any time.
directory_listing.granted: You agreed to appear in the directory.
directory_listing.notGranted: You do not appear in the directory.

photo_publication.title: Publishing your photo
photo_publication.lead: Optional: if you agree, your profile photo may accompany your name on the portal (committee directory). Without this agreement, only you can see it. Withdrawal takes effect immediately for the photo.
photo_publication.granted: You agreed to the publication of your photo.

myData.title: My data
myData.exportLead: JSON file with your account, profile, addresses, two-factor authentication status (without any secret), roles, invitations, consents, emails received and your actions over the last 12 months.
myData.anonymizeLead: Immediate and permanent: your address, profile, two-factor authentication and sessions are erased, your roles revoked, and you will no longer be able to sign in.
myData.anonymizeKept: The action log and the history of your consents are kept as evidence, without your address or name. If you have an active management role, hand it over first.
myData.understood: I understand that this operation is permanent.

site.errorLead: The content of this page could not be loaded. Please try again in a moment.
site.callLead: Accepted formats, deadlines and document templates. Proposals will be submitted in the author area once the call opens.
site.comingSoon: This page will be completed soon.
site.committeeSoon: The committee membership will be published soon.
site.timezone: Times shown in the conference time zone ({{zone}}).

list.title: My submissions
list.lead: Your proposals for the current edition and their status.
list.closed: The call for papers is not open: no new submission is possible.
list.profileIncomplete: Complete your profile (first name, last name, institution, country) before submitting.

edit.title: Submission
edit.lead: Complete each step; the summary shows what is missing before you submit.

save.conflict: This submission was changed elsewhere (another tab or device). Reload it before continuing: your latest unsaved changes will be lost.

info.autosave: Information and declarations are saved automatically.

authors.lead: List all authors in publication order, including yourself, with at least one corresponding author.
authors.author: Author {{n}}

policy.none: This submission type does not require a file.
policy.optional: Optional PDF file, {{max}} MB at most.
policy.required: Required PDF file, {{max}} MB at most.

file.chooseType: First choose a submission type ("Information" step).
file.doubleBlind: Double-blind review: remove your names, affiliations and acknowledgements from your file. PDF metadata (author, software) is removed on upload.

declarations.originality: I certify that this work is original and is not under review elsewhere.
declarations.ethics: I certify that this work complies with the applicable research ethics rules.
declarations.conflicts: I have declared, or will declare to the committee, any conflict of interest.
declarations.publication: If accepted, I agree to the publication of the abstract in the programme and the proceedings.
declarations.version: Provisional texts: a new version of the declarations will require a new acceptance.

review.complete: Your submission is complete: you can submit it.
review.submitted: Submission recorded under reference {{reference}}. An acknowledgement has been sent to you by email.
review.duplicates: Warning: you already have a submission with the same title in this edition. Check that it is not a duplicate (submitting remains possible):

kinds.coauthor_added: You have been listed as a co-author of submission {{reference}} “{{title}}” ({{edition}}).
kinds.extension_granted: Extended deadline for your submission {{reference}} “{{title}}”, until {{until}}.
kinds.draft_reminder: Your draft “{{title}}” has not been submitted yet: the call closes on {{closes}}.
